questions: Should the replacement of spaces with underscores in words from mystrings apply to the entire text as a whole, or only to exact word matches after splitting? If a word in mystrings contains spaces and is replaced with underscores, should the resulting underscored string be treated as a single word for frequency counting, even if it contains underscores?
Should the function raise ValueError only when text is empty, or also when mystrings is empty? The prompt only mentions text.

Is the frequency counting case-insensitive after replacement, or only during replacement? The clarification says 'applies to both', but does counting compare lowercased versions or original?
